function.description: Use this when the final answer table is determined. This is the only way to submit the answer to the user/evaluator; plain text answers will be ignored.
function.name: answer

from_csv.description: Optional absolute path to a CSV file containing the answer table (header row + data rows). When set, `columns` and `rows` MUST be empty. Use this for tables >= 30 rows or >= 200 cells to avoid burning decode tokens re-emitting the table as JSON. Convention: write the CSV from `execute_python` under `os.environ['DABENCH_ANSWER_DIR']`.

rows.description: Answer rows; each row's length must match the columns array.
